data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: BOOK, Map search, origin, search type, flexible dates, then Search, with the same parameters. It also covers the result-list click, but making search type and flexible dates optional, and leaving their allowed values vague, makes it slightly less concrete for automation.
